newsitem.title: UK: Lilley to be UK Conservative shadow chancellor.
newsitem.headline: Lilley to be UK Conservative shadow chancellor.

text.p: Peter Lilley was named finance spokesman of the opposition Conservative party on Friday, the BBC said, quoting party sources.

Lilley, formerly the secretary of state for social security, will shadow Chancellor of the Exchequer Gordon Brown, who due to present his first budget on July 2. The party press office was unavailable for immediate comment.

New party leader William Hague also named former home secretary Michael Howard as shadow foreign secretary, former health secretary Stephen Dorrell as shadow environment spokesman, and former Welsh secretary John Redwood as shadow shadow trade and industry secretary.
Lilley, Howard and Redwood had all contested the Conservative party leadership, while Dorrell pulled out after the first round.
